Product Details: Bright & Energy-Saving: Experience 850 lumens of powerful cool white (6500K) brightness which makes it best solar flood light for garden, balcony & security areas. Runs entirely on solar energy, giving you ₹0 power cost every month. High-Performance Battery: Equipped with a long-lasting 4000mAh LiFePO₄ rechargeable battery, delivering up to 14 hours of illumination (Auto Mode) on a single full charge – ensuring uninterrupted light through the night. Fast Solar Charging: Exclusively developed for Indian solar conditions that allow full charge in just 4 – 6 hours with its premium monocrystalline solar panel and also ensures efficient charging even in partial sunlight/ cloudy days. Weatherproof & Durable: Built to last with an IP65-rated waterproof and dustproof ABS body and tempered glass front – ideal for year-round outdoor use in rain, dust, or heat. Smart Remote Control: Enjoy one-touch convenience with multiple lighting modes – ON/OFF, Bright/Dim, 2H/4H/6H timers, and Auto Dusk-to-Dawn mode – for effortless control and energy efficiency. No Wiring, Easy Setup: Simple plug-and-play installation with the included 2m cable – mount on poles, walls, or rooftops for instant lighting. Best solar flood light for lawn, farmhouse, parking lots, gardens, terraces and wide compound areas. Engineered for Indian Outdoors: BIS-approved components, 12-month warranty, and Dylect’s trusted after-sales support ensure performance that’s built for India’s climate and consumers.
